name: Ghostfreak
abilities: Intangibility (selective; can chill or incapacitate by passing through)
Prehensile tentacles hidden under his skin
Movable eye giving 360-degree vision; night vision
True form: energy beams and dark-empowerment
weaknesses: Solidified protoplasm (Kraab's orange liquid) removes intangibility/invisibility
Intangibility needs conscious activation - can be hit off-guard
Electricity, Corrupturas hurt or control him when tangible
Cannot possess mindless zombies, Omnitrix forms or Dagon; strong wills can eject him
Zs'Skayr's consciousness hijacked the form in OS (sunlight weakness of the true form)
summary: Ben's grey ghost: phases through walls, vanishes, possesses enemies and hides a nightmare of tentacles under his skin - powered by DNA that once took Ben over.
traits: DNA came from Zs'Skayr, High Ecto-Lord of Anur Phaetos
One eye slides along the lines on his body
Ben feared using him until Omniverse
notableFeats: Beat Kraab (Hunted) and scared Zombozo into defeat (Last Laugh)
Incapacitated Thumbskull by phasing into his body (Ghostfreaked Out)
Possessed Michael Morningstar to break his spell (Mystery, Incorporeal)
Escaped Sentient Ultimate Spidermonkey's webbing (The Ultimate Sacrifice)
Possessed Ma Vreedle to call off the Pretty Boys (Vreedlemania)

appearances.designNotes: Grey skin with black lines, pink eye with black pupil, claw hands, original Omnitrix peeking from his skin on the lower-left chest; black-and-white striped tentacles under the skin.
Identical to Zs'Skayr's Alien Force design - purple body - but with a green eye and the Omnitrix on his chest.

appearances.designNotes: Peppermint-grey skin, dark green chains across the front leading to neck/waist/chest with the Omnitrix at their centre, elbow spikes back, two cuffs per arm, green eye, black-and-purple tentacles; glows green when possessing.

scoring.rationale: Intangibility, invisibility and possession make him nearly untouchable and able to end fights without a punch, plus flight and space survival. Loses it all if his protoplasm is solidified or he is caught off-guard, and in OS the form's donor personality overrode Ben.

notes: Wiki AF 'Season 2' = spec's AF Season 3, so AF usedBy is ben-16-af (Ghost Town).

In OS Ben lost Ghostfreak when Zs'Skayr escaped (Ghostfreaked Out); re-scanned in Be Afraid of the Dark but never used again in OS; used once each in AF and UA; freely used from OV's Mystery, Incorporeal.
Also used by Bad Ben (And Then There Were None) - not counted.
